description: Find the closest available cars to a location using live fleet GPS. Give a target as an airport code (LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY, EDI, SOU, BHX, MAN), a UK postcode, or lat+lng. Returns the nearest available cars (online, not on a job) with a drive ETA rounded to 5 minutes, grouped by car class; on hosts that show UI it renders as the 'Cars near you' card. Add `destination` when the customer also says where they are going ('any cars near Heathrow to take me to the Hilton Paddington?'): the result then also carries the FIXED FARES for that trip for every car class (same engine as london_airport_transfer_quote; pickup = now plus the nearest car's ETA unless transfer_date / transfer_time are given) and the card shows Book buttons — do not call the quote tool as well. Call once per question; the card is the complete answer. WHEN THE CARD IS SHOWN, DO NOT REPEAT ITS CONTENT: no table or list of cars, fares or ETAs in your text — the customer is looking at them on the card. Reply with one or two short sentences only (for example which car fits their group, or ask for passengers and suitcases if unknown, or 'Tap Book on the car you want'). Only when the host cannot show the card (your reply would be the customer's only view) list the cars and fares in text. Set min_pax to require a vehicle size. Customers and partner agents get an availability view only — car class (Saloon / People Carrier / 8 Seater, executive flag), seats and ETA for up to 5 cars; NO driver name, vehicle, plate, position, distance or fleet size (driver details are shared only after a booking is confirmed). Staff see the full detail and can include busy drivers. Prices are final — quote them exactly as returned.

destination.description: Optional drop-off (full postcode, address, London landmark, station or uniquely named hotel; airports are fine). When given, the result also carries the fixed fares from the target to this destination for every car class, and the card shows Book buttons.

include_on_job.description: Also include drivers currently on a job (default false = available only).

min_pax.description: Only vehicles seating at least this many passengers.

passengers.description: With destination: passenger count if the customer said it (marks the recommended car).

postcode.description: UK postcode, e.g. "SW1A 1AA", or just the district, e.g. "SL4".

transfer_date.description: With destination: travel date YYYY-MM-DD for a LATER trip. Default = today (Europe/London).

transfer_time.description: With destination: pickup time HH:MM (Europe/London) for a later trip. Default = now plus the nearest car's ETA, rounded up to 5 minutes — an ASAP pickup, whose under-3-hours surcharge is already in the fare.
